info.name: Referee - Match API
info.description: APIs used by authenticated referees for assigned tournament/match operations.

request.description: Always call GET Toss first to check `data.toss.state`. The state drives which UPDATE action is permitted next.

item.name: Update Toss
item.description:
Action depends on current state:
- `TOSS_PENDING` → `CALL` (or `ENTER_RESULT` for manual)
- `TOSS_CALLING` → `FLIP` (or `ENTER_RESULT`)
- `DECISION_PENDING` → `SET_DECISION`
- `STARTING_SETUP_PENDING` → `SET_STARTING_PLAYERS`
- `TOSS_COMPLETED` → NO further mutation allowed

response.name: 409 Conflict - CALL after completed
response.body:
{
    "success": false,
    "message": "Match toss has already been completed.",
    "errors": null,
    "data": {
        "match": [],

        "format": [],
        "teams": [],
        "toss": {
            "enabled": true,
            "method": "coin",
            "state": "TOSS_COMPLETED",
            "is_started": true,
            "is_result_decided": true,
            "is_completed": true,
            "next_action": null,
            "allowed_actions": [],
            "runtime": {
                "is_started": true,
                "is_completed": true,
                "next_action": null,
                "allowed_actions": []
            }
        }
    }
}
